scheme_name: Coastal Aquaculture Authority (CAA) Licensing for Startups
overview: The Coastal Aquaculture Authority (CAA) Licensing for Startups scheme regulates coastal aquaculture activities in India, ensuring environmental protection and responsible farming practices. It mandates registration of coastal aquaculture farms and hatcheries, issues certificates of compliance for antibiotic-free inputs, and promotes sustainable aquaculture through guidelines and monitoring. The scheme applies to all coastal areas across India.
objectives: Regulate coastal aquaculture activities to prevent environmental detriment
Promote responsible coastal aquaculture in compliance with the Act, Rules, and Guidelines
Protect the livelihood of people living in coastal areas
Ensure complete registration of coastal aquaculture farms and hatcheries
Promote sustainable practices and environmental responsibility in coastal aquaculture
eligibility: Any person carrying on coastal aquaculture shall register their farm with the Coastal Aquaculture Authority. Application must be made in Form-I with documents as per Schedule-II of CAA Rules, 2024, along with the prescribed processing fee. For hatcheries, Form-II is required with documents as per Schedule-II and payment of registration fee of rupees ten thousand. For antibiotic-free aquaculture inputs, Form-III is required with documents as per Schedule-III and a non-refundable processing fee of ten thousand rupees.
benefits: Registration provides legal authorization to operate coastal aquaculture farms and hatcheries. Certificate of Compliance for Antibiotic-Free Aquaculture Inputs allows manufacturers to market certified inputs. The scheme ensures biosecurity, disease-free broodstock, and sustainable practices. It supports access to certified inputs, promotes exports, and protects coastal livelihoods.
financial_support: The scheme does not provide direct financial support such as grants, loans, or subsidies. Financial obligations include payment of processing fees: rupees ten thousand for hatchery and live feed unit registration, and a non-refundable processing fee of ten thousand rupees for renewal of Certificate of Compliance for Aquaculture Inputs. No fund size or grant amount per entity is specified.
application_process: 1. Identify the appropriate form based on activity: Form-I for farm registration/renewal, Form-II for hatchery/NRH/Live Feed Unit registration, Form-III for Certificate of Compliance for Aquaculture Inputs. 2. Prepare documents as per the respective Schedule (I, II, or III) of CAA Rules, 2024. 3. Pay the required fee: Rs. 10,000 for Form-I and Form-II applications; Rs. 10,000 non-refundable processing fee for Form-III renewal. 4. Submit the application with documents and fee to the Coastal Aquaculture Authority, Chennai, or through the designated Sub-Divisional Level Committee (SDLC) or District Level Committee (DLC). 5. Await inspection and approval by the Authority as per the laid-down procedure in rules 9, 10, and 11 of CAA Rules, 2024.
required_documents: Form-I (Application for Registration or Renewal of Coastal Aquaculture Unit or Activity)
Form-II (Application for Registration or Renewal of Coastal Aquaculture Unit or Activity for Hatcheries, NRHs, BMCs, NBCs, Live Feed Units)
Form-III (Application for Certificate of Compliance for Antibiotic-Free Aquaculture Inputs)
Documents as per Schedule-II of CAA Rules, 2024 (for Forms I and II)
Documents as per Schedule-III of CAA Rules, 2024 (for Form III)
Proof of payment of processing fee (Rs. 10,000 for Forms I and II; Rs. 10,000 non-refundable for Form III renewal)
Declaration of sufficient cause for delay (if applicable, as per Rule 13(3) of CAA Rules 2024)
deadlines: Renewal of farm registration shall be made within 60 days before expiry of registration. Renewal of Certificate of Compliance for Aquaculture Inputs must be submitted three months before expiry. No fixed deadline for new applications; processed on receipt basis.
implementing_agency: Coastal Aquaculture Authority, Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Government of India
contact_details: Email: caaheadoffice[at]caa[dot]gov[dot]in | Phone: 044-2435 3502 / 044-2435 3784 | Address: Secretary, Coastal Aquaculture Authority, 5th Floor, Integrated Office Complex for Animal Husbandry and Fisheries Department, Fanepet, Nandanam, Chennai-600 035, Tamilnadu, India.
caveats: Registration is mandatory for all persons carrying on coastal aquaculture.
Certificate of Compliance for Aquaculture Inputs is product-specific and cannot be used for other products.
Failure to renew Certificate of Compliance within stipulated time results in automatic cancellation upon expiry.
Expired certification numbers must not be used on product labels or packaging.
Violation of certification rules may lead to legal action by the Task Force Team or Coastal Aquaculture Authority.
